name: outseen-cost-approval
description: Asks before Claude launches AWS resources over your monthly cost limit, and estimates AWS costs from CLI commands, Terraform plans and CloudFormation templates before anything is created.

monthly_limit_usd.title: Monthly limit (USD)
monthly_limit_usd.description: Claude asks you before a launch whose estimated monthly cost may exceed this amount.

default_region.title: Default AWS region
default_region.description: Region to assume when a command or template doesn't name one.

ask_when_unpriced.title: Ask when the cost can't be read
ask_when_unpriced.description: Also ask before terraform apply, cdk deploy and other launches whose cost can't be read from the command.
